activation_and_call_graph.selector: SWOXYGEN=2 and SWOXYGENTYPE=1 selects OxygenStress; distinct from C1 reproduction and C2 Feddes.
owners: RootExtraction dispatches to macro or micro according to the drought/root-uptake selector.
The oxygen branch runs in iTask=2, in ascending node order through noddrz, after per-call factor-array initialization.
OxygenStress consumes current-node hydraulic, thermal, soil-material, crop and atmospheric inputs and returns a factor to existing root extraction.
For node 1, c_top(1) is derived from current atmospheric temperature; each node writes c_top(node+1) for the next node in the same profile sweep.
SOLVE has UseZBREND=.TRUE.; ZBREND evaluates myfunc, which runs MICRO and MACRO. MACRO's inner Newton solve and SWAP-007 guard remain reachable when its depletion branch is entered.
activation_and_call_graph.output_boundary: rwu_factor modifies root extraction. The existing root-water-uptake owner remains the only accepted nodewise sink and water-mass authority.

writes: c_top(1) from atmosphere when node==1 and the gas-filled-porosity early exit is not taken
c_top(node+1) from computed or early-exit c_macro
vertical_profile_buffer.interpretation: Saved module storage is used as an in-call sequential vertical profile buffer. It is not proven to be independent physical continuation state; reset/retry/run-lifecycle behavior needs executable characterization.

one_time_derived_cache.declaration: Local arrays in OxygenStress under procedure SAVE; populated by calc_ini_pars on first entry while ini is true.
one_time_derived_cache.construction_inputs: watcon at campbell_h100, campbell_h500 and gfp_h100, plus current cofgen node parameters and Campbell thresholds.
one_time_derived_cache.invalidation_evidence: OxygenStress sets ini false after construction and has no local invalidation path. Whether enclosing application initialization guarantees a fresh process/module instance is not established by this member-only census.

save_surface_census.solver_scratch: MACRO counters and l/fi/fi_a/lnew plus ZBREND interval variables are local solver variables, not O2_pars fields. myfunc mutates shared O2_pars scratch during root-node evaluations.
save_surface_census.reset_observation: reset_rootextraction clears root sink/result arrays but does not reference or reset O2_pars or OxygenStress saved ini/cache fields. No end-to-end multi-run reset claim is made.

swap007_trace.guard: abs(fi_a) > max(tiny(1.0d0), abs(fi)/huge(1.0d0)) before fi/fi_a; otherwise lnew=huge(1.0d0)
swap007_trace.existing_restart_route: lnew > 1.d3 increments lnew_initial by 0.1, resets the sub-counter and retries; the existing global iteration ceiling calls swap_error.
swap007_trace.outer_solver_context: SOLVE sets UseZBREND=.TRUE.; its callback reaches MACRO, where the guarded inner Newton update lives.
swap007_trace.numerical_authority: reference/swap-4.3.1/patches/SWAP-007; robustness correction only, no authorization to change physical equations or solver policy.

unknowns_and_guards.restart_payload: No production restart or transaction rollback test of O2_pars/cache/profile-buffer state was performed.
unknowns_and_guards.multi_simulation_lifecycle: No source-local invalidation of ini/cache was found; caller process lifecycle and cross-run behavior remain unqualified.

next_safe_slice: PPA-WU05-C3A pure derived-cache algebra is implemented; next isolate the existing SWAP-007 representability/restart decision without runtime binding
